$comment: Built on SIP — Proving Ground lane registry. Maps each lane to the existing eval infra it composes. The Proving Ground does not duplicate measurement; it unifies it.

lanes.title: Model
lanes.measures: Capability + instruction compliance + behavioral safety of models run in-harness
lanes.verification: self-verifying asserts + ground-truth + blind non-contestant judge

lanes.title: Memory
lanes.measures: recall@k, precision@10, latency p50/p95 of the memory substrate
lanes.verification: replay-only recall against real voice-session corpus; no synthetic benchmarks
lanes.status: harness live; Phase-0 dog-food in progress; precision@10 baseline = 0.20

lanes.title: Retrieval
lanes.measures: BM25/FTS5 ranking quality on the public golden corpus
lanes.verification: labeled query set against shipped public-vault corpus
lanes.status: live; baseline 100% recall@5 on 10 labeled queries

lanes.title: Harness
lanes.measures: Trust-contract + envelope + privacy + provenance integrity (7 risk dimensions)
lanes.verification: isolated temp-server assertions per risk dimension
lanes.status: live; 34 pass / 0 fail / 7 todo (28 pass at first baseline)

lanes.title: Substrate
lanes.measures: Symmetry invariants — CLAUDE.md<->AGENTS.md, skill-rules<->skills, vertical coverage
lanes.verification: structural symmetry assertions with EXEMPT ledgers

lanes.title: Datasets
lanes.measures: Provenance + labeling honesty of every eval set (no synthetic-benchmark smuggling)
lanes.receipts: this lane is an audit, not a metric — verdict only
lanes.verification: manual + scripted: every dataset names its source and labeling method

lanes.title: System
lanes.measures: Unifying scorecard + Luminor-kernel Overseer synthesis across lanes 1-6
lanes.verification: composition of lane verdicts + named system-level weakness

lanes.title: Income & Payments Safety
lanes.measures: Whether the income & payment stack REJECTS and AUDITS 6 adversarial attack classes (R1 prompt injection, R2 affiliate-link tampering, R3 disclosure removal, R4 mandate forgery, R5 spend-cap bypass, R6 capital exfiltration). L7 assurance layer of the agentic-income ecosystem.
lanes.receipts: rounds/income-payments-safety-v0.1.md (probes + expected verdicts); scorecards/income-payments-safety-v0.2.json (live JSON scorecard); scorecards/income-payments-safety-v0.1.md (markdown scorecard)
lanes.verification: per-probe: PASS only if the malicious action is REJECTED and AUDITED — silent non-failure is a FAIL. R4/R5/R6 run live against the payments MCP (verify_mandate / check_spend_cap / tool registry); R3 is a static disclosure + JSON-LD-escape source check; R1/R2/C1/C2/C3 remain PENDING (need live agents). MCP-graceful: cross-repo probes degrade to PENDING when the dependency is absent. Each probe paired to a named blue defense from the charter (no orphan probes).
lanes.status: v0.2 — PARTIAL (runnable harness; R4/R5/R6 PASS live + R3 PASS static when deps present; R1/R2/C1/C2/C3 PENDING; degrades to all-PENDING in dependency-free CI)

lanes.title: Deep Reasoning (R5)
lanes.measures: Whether the expensive model tiers buy materially fewer wrong answers than the cheap tiers on reasoning tasks where one wrong intermediate step propagates — and whether that margin justifies their price multiple. Cost-adjusted: per-run token and cost accounting, reported as cost per PASSED task.
lanes.receipts: out/r5-deep-reasoning-*.json (run-local); a reviewed run is promoted to rounds/ by hand
lanes.verification: fully mechanical — each task declares ground truth and accepting regexes matched against the reply's final ANSWER line; pre-registered attractors distinguish a near-miss from noise. No LLM judge: all four Claude tiers are contestants, so no Claude model is a non-contestant judge (see R5-DESIGN.md section 6). Binary scoring, no partial credit. Credential-graceful: with no usable model credential the harness emits an UNRUN receipt with zero result rows rather than any number.
lanes.status: v0.1 — RAN 2026-08-28, verdict VOID-EQUIVALENT. Receipt: rounds/2026-08-28-r5-deep-reasoning.json. The card was executed twice; run 1 scored 6/6 for all four tiers (spread 0, VOID by the pre-registered rule) and run 2 scored 5/6/6/6/5 where BOTH non-PASS cells are non-reasoning (one transport error, one missing answer line). Across both runs 46 of 46 answered cells were correct and not one of the twelve pre-registered attractors was taken. The lane is live and reproducible, but it has NOT separated the tiers: routing-table.json stays at rounds=0, confidence=low, autoApply=false, because a void-equivalent round is not evidence and does not count toward the A2 two-round floor.

lanes.title: Session Continuity
lanes.measures: Whether recovered session intent stays honest end to end: only complete interactive /goal requests or an interactive thread's native Codex goal gain authority; untrusted claims are quarantined with a reason; import survives crash and replay; nothing resumes, admits or completes without the registered owner and the required proofs.
lanes.entrypoint: harness/session-continuity.mjs (runnable) + harness/continuity/pins.json (pinned sources) + fixtures/continuity/golden/ (recorded collector output)
lanes.receipts: out/session-continuity-*.json (run-local; uploaded as a CI artifact by .github/workflows/continuity.yml)
lanes.verification: synthetic interactive, headless, partial and clipped transcripts plus a SQLite goal store in Codex's thread_goals schema run through the agentic-ops collector and the SIS importer, both fetched at pinned SHAs and refused on any sha256 mismatch. Also runs both repos' own continuity regression tests and agentic-ops lifecycle/continuity-proof.js unmodified. mutation-check.mjs proves each of nine injected regressions turns the lane red.
lanes.status: v0.1 — PASS locally with the collector leg (104/104 checks). CI is PARTIAL until the AGENTIC_OPS_READ_TOKEN secret is configured, because agentic-ops is private. No live harness and no installed release are tested.
